D.t: Dione Sims trails by 8.6 and wins 11% of simulations. Closing it takes about 11,571 voters switching sides, or 23,142 more net votes from new turnout.
In 8 of 10 simulations the result lands between R +17.2 and R +0.2. Only an unusual polling error changes the winner.

D.t: The early vote has moved this forecast 0.2 points toward Dione Sims. Bank it: chase the remaining mail ballots and low propensity voters who have not voted.
